title: Studio report Properties: switching Report type to Joined autosaves a report with no blocks (422), and later edits are refused and lost on reload with no prompt
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (studio-authoring.report-authoring-options), reach: the Studio autosave, measured 3 times.
Business reason: a report author who switches a report to Joined and touches anything before adding the first block sees "Changes not saved", and every edit is then refused and lost on reload without a prompt. #27785 holds an added Order or Blocks item and a chart type picked before its axes; the type switch itself is the remaining door into the same loss.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts`. QA suggestion only: `area:studio`, p2.
Duplicate search: `joined report Studio blocks` → 65 hits; #27785 (closed) is the sibling for list items and chart axes, #21702 (closed) the spec side of a joined report with no dataset; none is the type switch.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` → nav "+" → Report → a name, a dataset and a measure → Save as draft (PUT 200, `type: summary`).
2. In Properties set Report type = Joined. Studio autosaves `{"type":"joined","drilldown":true,…}` with dataset and values dropped and no blocks → 422 at `blocks`, "a `joined` report needs `blocks`".
3. Edit Description → the PUT carries the same body plus the description → 422.
4. Reload: no beforeunload guard (`defaultPrevented` false) and no prompt; the report is back to Summary and the description is gone.

Expected: the switch is held until a block is complete, or the refused edits are guarded on leave. Actual: as above. Reproduced 3 times on fresh loads.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`reportHeldEdit` in `metadataError.ts` does not treat a joined report with no `blocks` as held.

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.report-authoring-options · observed beside the clauses
